import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String inputStr = scanner.nextLine();

        // Replace first occurrence of 'at' with '@'
        int index = inputStr.indexOf("at");
        if (index != -1) {
            inputStr = inputStr.substring(0, index) + "@" + inputStr.substring(index + 2);
        }

        // Replace all 'dot' with '.'
        inputStr = inputStr.replace("dot", ".");

        // If string starts with '.', add 'dot' at the beginning
        if (inputStr.startsWith(".")) {
            inputStr = "dot" + inputStr.substring(1);
        }

        // If string starts with '@', replace first 'at' with '@' and add 'at' at start
        if (inputStr.startsWith("@")) {
            int atIndex = inputStr.indexOf("at");
            if (atIndex != -1) {
                inputStr = "at" + inputStr.substring(atIndex + 2);
            }
        }

        // If string ends with '.', replace with 'dot'
        if (inputStr.endsWith(".")) {
            inputStr = inputStr.substring(0, inputStr.length() - 1) + "dot";
        }

        System.out.println(inputStr);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
